senses.gloss: f. (רָגַע; cmp. רִגְיָא) [balance,] compromise, agreement on average weights or prices.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 11:25">Tosef. B. Mets. XI, 25</cite> <he>רשאין … לעשות ר׳ ביניהם</he> (Var. <cite ref="T00169"><he>רגועה</he></cite>) the bakers of a place are permitted to form a combination settling the weight or price of bread.
